answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a verifiable orbital slot and a bonded stake, so a jade ledger entry records the signed ephemeris of every node. Colluders hiding across a tundra of forged keys must still post a haven deposit per identity, and cross-checks of independent tracking attestations expose duplicates. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
